Missing/unparseable facts fail the predicate. |
| Re-plan | `failStep` treats an `errorClass:'replan'` failure on a phase whose manifest declares `backEdges` as a back-edge: it writes `engine.error`, resets the target + later committed steps (`state:'reset'` + `{reset:'replan',fromPhase,reason}`), increments `runs.replans`; `runspec` re-issues the plan phase with `inputs.replan{fromPhase,reason,count}`; `harness-loop` routes the reset through. At `ITERATION_CAPS.replan=2` the next failure opens a blocking `refusal` Approval and parks `waiting_gate`; `resolveGate` marks the failed grounding step done on proceed/cut so the run advances. |
| Gate | `keep_planning` is exactly-once (prior `keep_planning` decisions counted: first resets the plan step + `replans++`, later ones proceed `fromStep:'next'`). `commitStep` pre-resolves `approve_plan` `by:'trial'`/`proceed_as_proposed` on preview runs. |
| Delivery | `runDeliveryTransaction` `kind:'drafting_note'`: requires `newDraftN`, locates the committed `drafts/v{newDraftN}.md` version from the run's done steps (fail-closed if absent), marks it immutable, inserts the born-frozen `drafted_from_outline` row (no input-draft freeze); `draftPromotedVersionId` optional. `runspec` resolves Draft delivery from frozen `nextDraftId`/`nextDraftN`; `delivery-base.ts` returns `newDraftN` so `v(N+1)` write grants resolve. `run-routes` re-injects `newDraftN` server-side at the delivery POST. |
| Events | `harvestStep` parses the committed `04-draft-ledger.md` `## Sections` rows and emits `section.drafted{sectionRef,words,budget?}` in plan order, deduped on `sectionRef` against `run_events` (a re-harvest/retry cannot double-emit). `copy.ts` already renders "Section {sectionRef} — {words} words". |
| Api | `POST /projects/:id/runs` `workflow:'draft'`: verifies `body.draftId` is a project draft (the outline, `400 draft_outline_required` otherwise), reserves `nextDraftId`/`nextDraftN` server-side (max n + 1), freezes `inputs.preview{sections}` + `grounding:false`/`audit:false` on `preview`, and prices the `preview` estimator variant. |

## Decisions (recorded at implementation)

- **The born-frozen row reserves its id at creation.** `nextDraftId`/`nextDraftN` are frozen inputs
  (server-resolved like Revise's `nextDraftId`), re-injected at the delivery POST — the pod's
  dossier never supplies delivery facts.
- **`section.drafted` is emitted from committed bytes, in `harvestStep`.** The pod streams prose to
  the user live, but the EVENT (the budget bar's source) is derived only from the committed
  `04-draft-ledger.md` — never pod-supplied event text — and deduped on `sectionRef` against the
  durable `run_events` row.
- **Re-plan resets the whole suffix.** The back-edge target (`plan`) and every later committed step
  reset together; `committedPhases` derives from `done` rows so the reset re-counts honestly.
- **`keep_planning` ≠ grounding re-plan.** The user's Keep-planning action is capped at one reset
  (exactly-once via prior decisions); the grounding back-edge is `ITERATION_CAPS.replan=2` +
  refusal escalation. Two distinct counters, one `runs.replans` column.
- **Draft delivery fails closed on a missing `drafts/vN.md`.** If the Writing phase never committed
  the artifact, `DeliveryValidationError` — the run cannot deliver a note about a draft that does
  not exist.

## Stage B handoff (operator — D-P1.10-1)

Deploy `api` + `run-task` (image bump) + `web` to `dev` — no migrations, no new env. Launch a
preview (`{workflow:'draft', preview:true, draftId:<outline>}`) and assert: `inputs.nextDraftId`/
`nextDraftN`/`preview` frozen; the run runs intake→plan (Approve plan `by:'trial'`)→draft→delivery;
one `section.drafted` event; a `kind:'drafting_note'` correspondence row + born-frozen
`drafted_from_outline` v(N+1) draft. A full non-preview run exercises the live Approve-plan
structured edit (D-P0.15-3's live leg) and, if forced, the re-plan cap → refusal path.
